frames.observation: The exact Bronzewake boots and shin guards are readable on both legs in settled 2HandWield_CombatIdle at 11 HP. They remain aligned below the native body and form a coherent low-poly silhouette.
At the transition into 2HandWield_CriticalAttack the feet advance with the legs and retain their expected orientation while the exact boots renderer stays visible.
The critical lunge carries both authored boots into the close attack pose without sampled detachment, inversion, or vertex burst. The impact flash and foreground hero partly obscure the lower legs.
During critical-attack recovery the near shin guard remains centered on the lower leg and the far boot stays attached despite hero overlap.
The model has returned to 2HandWield_CombatIdle with both authored boots seated beneath the native trousers and no visible gap or orientation error.
A later idle sample preserves the expected boot placement, but strong camera motion blur prevents fine edge or texture inspection in this exact frame.
The ordinary no-focus attack begins from a settled 11 HP combat-idle pose with the exact boots visible and aligned on both feet.
At the native DamagedHeavy trigger boundary the target is mostly hidden by the hero and impact sphere. This frame establishes timing but provides little fine footwear evidence.
During 2HandWield_HitBig the champion is lifted backward while both boots follow their lower-leg bones coherently. The ordinary 10-damage label is visible as HP resolves toward 1.
The final heavy-hit frame returns the target toward standing at 1 HP with both shin guards still attached and correctly oriented.
The native 2HandWield_BasicAttack begins from the recovered 1 HP stance with both authored boots planted under the body.
At basic-attack contact the champion closes on the hero and both feet remain connected to the animated legs. The large Steadfast effect obscures most lower-body surface detail.
After the basic attack the target settles back into combat idle with both authored boots readable and aligned.
The separate explicit KillSingle fixture begins from a settled 1 HP combat-idle pose with both exact boots visible.
At the explicit fixture impact, the bright sphere and hero obscure the target. This frame supports fixture timing and is not used for a detailed deformation claim.
The native Death transition has begun and the target recoils with red particles. The exact boots remain aligned immediately before all 11 surviving rigid bodies become nonkinematic at frame 28.
During the native ragdoll fall the body bends backward while the authored boots remain attached at the feet without sampled stretching or inversion.
The ragdoll has reached a floor pose with both lower legs and footwear still forming a coherent visible shape. Depth blur limits fine surface inspection.
The same sampled ragdoll floor pose remains visible at the final retained frame. Camera focus limits detail, and no corpse lifetime beyond this controller-boundary capture is claimed.

requirements: All 19 referenced original PNGs were inspected at original resolution before assigning this reviewed status.
The ordinary no-focus gameplay claim is limited to the same-target HP change from 11 to 1; the separate KillSingle fixture at 1 HP is not ordinary lethal evidence.
The death claim is a sampled native ragdoll prefix: m_DoRagdoll is true, the body set changes from 15 to 11 at frame 26, and all 11 surviving bodies become nonkinematic at frame 28.
The exact boots renderer remained active, enabled and visible in all 330 retained frames; selected originals support visual conclusions only for their sampled views.
Native sibling surfaces, combat UI, attack effects, foreground hero overlap, depth blur and camera movement limit fine surface, culling and corpse inspection.
